text.p: Following are some of the main
stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified
these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
HET FINANCIEELE DAGBLAD
- Pension fund PGGM sells its entire U.S portfolio,
worth 2.1 billion guilders, to Cornerstone properties. (p1)
- Dutch carrier KLM unveils alliance with
Norway's regional carrier Braathens SAFE . (p1)
- Information technology firm KSI plans listing on Amsterdam
new companies bourse NMAX next summer. (p1)
- PC store chain Commodore still hoping to be rescued by
computer maker Tulip . (p5)
- Dutch first quarter economic growth outstrips
expectations, rising 3.9 percent, compared with forecasts of
3.0 percent (p6).
DE VOLKSKRANT
- Economic affairs minister Hans Wijers wants to accelerate
the building of Schiphol Airport's fifth runway. (p1)
- Dutch PTT KPN mulling stock exchange float for its
cable TV division Vision Networks. (p2)
- FNV-affiliated unions in the services, industry and
transport sectors seeking 3.75 percent wage increases in 1998.
DE TELEGRAAF
- Agricultural minister Jozias van Aartsen sticks to his
plans to slim down Dutch pig breeding sector. (p21)
- Director A. Breure of Dutch biotechnology company Mogen
set to step down at end of the year. (p23)
TROUW
- Monday's 23.06 point gain on the AEX-index to 917.48
points takes pessimists by surprise. (p1)
ALGEMEEN DAGBLAD
- Oil and chemicals trader Petroplus takes over
Daewoo's refinery in Antwerp, Belgium. (p9)
